topPRs.title: kona-host: stop retrying terminal hint failures
topPRs.author: fakedev9999
topPRs.body:
Hint handlers can now mark a deterministic failure as non-retryable. The online backend returns that error immediately from both high-level and fine-grained hint fetches. Other fetch errors retain the existing backoff behavior.

A regression test covers both paths and wrapped errors. Local validation: 29 kona-host unit tests passed; focused formatting and clippy checks passed. This branch starts from kona-client/v1.7.0 to permit downstream revision pinning without an unrelated dependency upgrade.

topPRs.title: op-challenger: warn instead of error when the local node is behind the game L1 head
topPRs.author: geoknee
topPRs.body:
On super root games (e.g. sepolia-devnet-2) op-challenger has no sync validator, so a node that has not yet processed the game's L1 head is detected inside the trace provider and logged at Error as `Failed to calculate all required moves` once per game per L1 block. It is an expected wait state, and the noise buries real solver failures. The fault agent now recognises it and logs at Warn, matching what the single-chain path already does.

The message also names which node is behind and via which RPC (rollup node via `optimism_syncStatus`, or the super root source via `superroot_atTimestamp`) together with its current L1 block and the game's L1 head, e.g.:

```
local node too far behind: super root source (superroot_atTimestamp) current L1 block 9412001 must be above game L1 head 9412001
```

Operators see a Warn instead of an Error and can tell from the line which endpoint to look at. No behaviour change otherwise: the challenger still skips the game and retries on the next L1 block.

Not done here: giving the super root path a real sync validator so the check runs before the solver. That would save the wasted contract loads, but it is a larger change than a log-level fix.

Review: go-code-reviewer run; deletion-reviewer skipped, the only removed text is the old log message wording, which nothing else in the repo matches on.
